candidate_dispositions.explanation: The note reports outside-hospital treatment and suspected osteomyelitis, but does not say the patient was admitted. The admission entry asserts an unsupported event.
candidate_dispositions.source_quote: The patient initially took treatment at outside hospital where he was suspected to have right distal humerus osteomyelitis

candidate_dispositions.explanation: The note gives conflicting location information: it describes right-elbow complaints but says the pain began over the left elbow. The label’s right-elbow location is supported for the presenting complaint, so this is an ambiguity rather than a clear error.
candidate_dispositions.source_quote: A 27-year-old male came with complaints of the right elbow pain and stiffness for 3 years. The patient was apparently normal 3 years back. He started developing pain over the left elbow following a trivial trauma

candidate_dispositions.explanation: The label omits the reported biopsy result, a material diagnostic conclusion expressible in the diagnosis-test result field.

added_findings.explanation: The symptom details omit the pain quality and important aggravating and relieving factors.
The symptom entry omits the documented progressive course, a material temporal feature.

added_findings.source_quote: and hence, he had persistent pain even after the surgery
added_findings.explanation: The first surgery entry omits the documented persistence of pain afterward, a material outcome of the procedure.

added_findings.label_excerpt: Healed longitudinal surgical scar, swelling, tenderness, restricted range of movement, full forearm rotations, no distal neurovascular deficit
added_findings.source_quote: healed longitudinal surgical scar of length 6 cm present over the lateral aspect of the distal humerus and elbow
added_findings.explanation: The examination result omits the scar’s documented length and location, which add material specificity to the prior surgical finding.

added_findings.source_quote: Range of movement of the right elbow was 10–90° (active and passive) further restricted due to pain.
added_findings.explanation: The examination entry omits the measured range of motion and that both active and passive movement were limited, material detail about the restriction.

initial.summary: The unsupported admission assertion and omitted biopsy result are confirmed. The symptom-location concern is downgraded because the note itself gives conflicting locations. Material omitted symptom, procedure-outcome, and examination details are identified.
